subject: prd/installer
statement: If a required installation prerequisite, including git, is missing, then the system shall name the missing prerequisite and its remediation, claim no success, and leave doctor red; absence of Node.js or npm alone is not a failure
intent: a named prerequisite failure when a live prerequisite is absent
fit_criterion: removing git produces its named remediation and a doctor finding; removing only Node.js and npm permits init and doctor to complete
